body.name: Near-extremal neural feasible inner interval
body.construction: For independently certified \(M_-,M_+\in\mathcal F_{n,\mathrm N}\) satisfying \(Q(M_-)\le\ell_{n,\mathrm N}+\eta_{\mathrm{in}}\) and \(Q(M_+)\ge u_{n,\mathrm N}-\eta_{\mathrm{in}}\), set \(I_{\mathrm{in}}=[Q(M_-),Q(M_+)]\) after ordering the certified values.
